indicator.name: Registered vehicles (count, per capita)
indicator.description: Registered vehicles by county if a public county breakdown is confirmed.
indicator.expected_source: KNBS — 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census, Volume IV, Table 2.36
indicator.expected_availability_note: Retired/replaced in P21. No governed complete 47-county administrative registration table was identified. Use IND-HOUSEHOLD-MOTORCYCLE-OWNERSHIP and IND-HOUSEHOLD-CAR-OWNERSHIP for the separate KNBS 2019 Census household-ownership percentages. Do not interpret either successor as a registered-vehicle count, vehicle stock, NTSA registration location or vehicles per capita.
